# SYNESIS_E158 — Warning

## Description

Missing `MAP <fields> TO OUTPUT`.

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: no `MAP <fields> TO OUTPUT`. The output is what the model learns
  to produce, so it must be declared. Each key of the Alpaca line comes from `MAP <fields> TO INSTRUCTION | INPUT | OUTPUT`.
  Without any MAP or INSTRUCTION the block keeps the built-in Alpaca pairs.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **AlpacaOutputMapMissing**: `block`
